minutes.headline: ZBA granted a special permit for a dog boarding and daycare facility at 339 Electric Avenue, on the 2009 conditions.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a refiled special permit application for a dog kennel and daycare at 339 Electric Avenue. The building would also house a monument company and a grooming shop. With only four voting members, the applicant chose to go ahead. A motion to grant, referencing the 2009 conditions and hours, was made and seconded, and the chair said the motion carried. The board then adjourned.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit to operate the dog boarding facility and daycare as requested in the application, with the 2009 conditions and hours referenced.

decisions.decision: The applicant's engineer said they wanted to proceed that night, so the hearing went ahead with four voting members rather than continuing to the next meeting.
The board agreed the 2009 conditions and hours of operation would carry over to the new permit.
